title: PV Sindhu Prepares for French Open 2026 Semifinal Clash
indian_angle: Two-time Olympic medallist PV Sindhu is set to compete in the French Open 2026 semifinals, aiming for another major title this season.
summary: India's PV Sindhu is gearing up for her French Open 2026 semifinal match against Hina Akechi, with live streaming details now available for fans.

title: Thulasimathi-Manasi Clinch Para Asian Games Badminton Gold, India Crosses 100 Medals
indian_angle: The Indian duo of Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Girishchandra secured a historic gold medal in women's doubles SL3-SU5 badminton, contributing to India's best-ever medal haul at the Para Asian Games.
summary: Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Girishchandra triumphed in the women’s doubles SL3-SU5 event at the Para Asian Games 2026, securing India's 28th gold and pushing the nation past the 100-medal mark.

title: Ashmita Chaliha Stuns World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi at French Open
indian_angle: Indian southpaw Ashmita Chaliha delivered a stunning performance, defeating World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi at the French Open, marking a significant milestone in her career.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha created a major upset at the French Open, beating Japanese star Akane Yamaguchi 21-19, 21-18, becoming only the second Indian woman to achieve this feat.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: This committee will provide a direct voice for Indian badminton players in decision-making processes.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aiming to give players a greater role in the sport's governance.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will significantly impact how young Indian players compete in domestic ranking tournaments and national championships, potentially influencing their development.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
